name: Pflugerville
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pflugerville, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Pflugerville, TX: the nativity display, Pet Pictures with Santa, a live radio play of A Christmas Carol and more, with dates and costs.
lede: Pflugerville builds its Christmas season around downtown Main Street, where the city's Holiday Pfestivities bring a parade, a tree lighting and Santa, with church and museum traditions filling the rest of December.
celebrates: Pflugerville celebrates Christmas with a run of city events it calls Holiday Pfestivities, spelled with the extra P the town uses for nearly everything. The biggest night is the Pfestival of Lights and Parade on Main Street, where Santa arrives, lights the tree and stays for photos. Santa comes back the next morning to pose with pets at The Best Little Plaza in Texas. The Heritage House Museum holds a Christmas open house on the first Sunday in December, the Parks and Recreation department runs a holiday ornament craft night, and local churches add a nativity display and a live radio play of A Christmas Carol.
lastyear: In 2025 the city held its Pfestival of Lights and Parade on Saturday, December 6, from 4 to 7:30 pm, with the tree lighting, pictures with Santa and the parade downtown. Pflugerville Parks and Recreation hosted a Holiday Ornament Craft Night on December 12, where families made four DIY ornaments. The Heritage House Museum marked the season with winter treats and ornament making at its Christmas open house.
facts: Pflugerville is named for German settlers who began farming the area in 1849, starting with Henry Pfluger Sr., which is why the city likes to add a P to its event names. The town incorporated in July 1965 and counted 65,191 people in the 2020 census. Most of the city sits in Travis County, with a small part in Williamson County. The Heritage House Museum looks back to that German heritage at Christmas, sharing 1912 holiday traditions, German cookies and wassail.
trains: Rail shaped Pflugerville early: in 1904 the MKT Railroad finished a line between Georgetown and Austin that passed just outside town. Today the closest passenger rail is CapMetro's Red Line, which runs 10 stations from Downtown Austin to Leander; Howard station on Howard Lane in Northwest Austin is the nearest stop. Amtrak trains stop in Austin and Taylor. For a holiday train ride, the Austin Steam Train Association in Cedar Park runs the Hill Country Flyer and its Christmas North Pole Flyer.
train_links: Vintage train rides from Cedar Park, including the Hill Country Flyer and the North Pole Flyer at Christmas.
traditions: The city's downtown kickoff with a holiday parade, a vendor market and Santa lighting the tree on Main Street.
The morning after the Pfestival, Santa poses with leashed and carried pets on the downtown plaza while the Friends of the Pflugerville Animal Shelter collect donations.
On the first Sunday in December the Heritage House Museum fills with antique and handmade holiday displays, school choirs and a visit from Santa.
Pflugerville Parks and Recreation hosts an evening of DIY ornament making for families.
Local congregations of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints show hundreds of nativity scenes from around the world, with music and a kids' craft room.
On New Year's Day brave families welcome the new year by sliding into a chilly pool.
kidfact: Pflugerville got its name from Henry Pfluger, a German farmer who settled there in 1849. That is why the city loves putting a P at the front of words, like Pfestival and Pfreeze Pflop.
faq: When is the Pflugerville Christmas parade?

The Pfestival of Lights and Parade is held on a Saturday in early December in downtown Pflugerville, around 100 East Main Street. In 2025 it ran from 4 to 7:30 pm with the parade, a tree lighting and pictures with Santa. The city posts each year's schedule on its Holiday Pfestivities page, so check there for the current times.
Where can kids see Santa in Pflugerville?

Santa usually arrives at the Pfestival of Lights and Parade downtown, lights the tree and stays for photos. He also visits the Heritage House Museum's Christmas open house on the first Sunday in December, and the city hosts Pet Pictures with Santa on the downtown plaza so families can bring their dogs for a photo too.
What is the Heritage House Museum Christmas open house?

The Heritage House Museum at 901 Old Austin Hutto Road opens its doors on the first Sunday in December for a Christmas open house. Visitors see antique and handmade holiday displays, hear school choirs and meet Santa. The museum is also open on first Sundays from 1 to 4 pm and Tuesdays from 3 to 7 pm.
Why do Pflugerville events start with Pf?

The city is named for the Pfluger family, German settlers led by Henry Pfluger Sr. who began farming the area in 1849. Pflugerville leans into that heritage by adding a P to event names, which gives the season the Pfestival of Lights, Holiday Pfestivities and, on New Year's Day, the Pfreeze Pflop.
Is there a train near Pflugerville at Christmas?

There is no passenger station in Pflugerville. The nearest CapMetro Red Line stop is Howard station in Northwest Austin, and Amtrak stops in Austin and Taylor. For a Christmas train ride, families drive to Cedar Park, where the Austin Steam Train Association runs the North Pole Flyer during the holiday season.
